item.title: 18 Aug — Make 240 bps feel like 80 bps
item.description:
## The one thing If the vig feels heavy, retail won’t lean into the book; if the tape feels fair, they spray the ladder. We can’t change our on‑chain taker fee (240 bps, quadratic), so we have to change how it feels: depth at the touch, predictable fills, and a reason for makers to warehouse inventory.
## Mechanism — make 240 bps feel like 80 bps - Maker ladders at the touch: pre‑seed 1–3 ticks …
